title: Keypad Dialing
blurb: Four quick telephone keypad tones, and genuine DTMF at that: the dual-tone system phones actually use to dial. Each key sends two frequencies at once, one from a row and one from a column, and that is how the network tells a 5 from a 7 through noise. It is the sound of urgently calling someone in every film ever made. Use it before a phone-call scene, as a podcast transition, or anywhere you need instant we're-making-a-call energy. Synthesised to spec, so it is clean, original and free to use.
origin: Genuine DTMF dual-tone synthesis, using the same frequencies real phones dial with.
